name: choice-dialog
title: Choice dialog
description: A dialog for choosing between outcomes, not just yes or no: radio options with a line of consequence each, the safest preselected, and a confirm that names the choice.
docs: Pass title, description, options (id, label, description, destructive) and onConfirm(id, { remember }), plus a trigger, or open and onOpenChange to control it. The options are a radio group: arrow keys move, and Enter confirms. The first option that is not destructive is selected when it opens, so the safe answer is already chosen; defaultValue picks another. A destructive option takes the destructive style only while it is selected, and the confirm button follows it. confirmLabel is a string or a function of the chosen option, so the button reads "Delete all events"; without it the button repeats the option's label. rememberLabel adds a checkbox whose state is passed to onConfirm. Return a promise from onConfirm: while it is pending the whole dialog is locked, Escape and outside clicks included, and the button shows a spinner; when it resolves the dialog closes, and when it rejects the error message shows inside the dialog, which stays open for another try, and focus returns to the control that was pressed. The panel is never taller than the screen: the title and the buttons stay in view and the options scroll between them, so on a phone held sideways Confirm is still in reach. Nothing chosen last time is carried into the next opening.
